handwriting.title: Handwriting forensic expertise
handwriting.description: Handwriting forensic expertise is a tool for identifying the author of handwritten text or signature. Experts analyze handwritten and digital records to solve identification, diagnostic and classification tasks.

phonography.title: Phonographic forensic expertise
phonography.description: Phonographic expertise studies audio information on digital or magnetic media to determine key facts, transcribe unclear speech, identify speakers and detect editing.

phototechnical.title: Phototechnical forensic expertise
phototechnical.description: Phototechnical expertise focuses on photo, cinema and video material analysis and the equipment used to create them, including detection of edits and evaluation of shooting conditions.

accounting.title: Accounting forensic expertise
accounting.description: Accounting forensic expertise analyzes financial and business activities to verify correctness of accounting records and determine financial damages.

goods.title: Commodity forensic expertise
goods.description: Commodity expertise determines product characteristics, compliance with standards, defect analysis and valuation.

religion.title: Religious studies forensic research
religion.description: Systematic analysis to determine affiliation of materials to specific religious movements and to assess potentially dangerous rhetoric.

psychology.title: Psychological forensic expertise
psychology.description: Psychological expertise examines mental states and abilities of subjects to establish facts with legal significance.

history.title: history
paragraphs: ANSE was established in 2021 as an independent platform to develop private forensic expertise in Kazakhstan. The founders are professionals with over twenty years of experience in the state expert system, who progressed from practicing experts to leaders. The move to an independent format allowed building an organization based on professionalism, transparency and personal responsibility, with quality control and scientific approach becoming part of corporate culture.
Today ANSE is an interregional forensic organization combining specialists with long-term practice and a scientific approach to research.

mission.title: mission
mission.intro: The Alliance is a professional community where truth is not a legal category but a value at the core of the profession. Professionalism, methodology and ethics form the foundation of a new culture of evidence in forensic activity.

values.title: Professionalism
values.description: Broad professionalism aimed at expanding competencies through diverse cooperation, including with universities, foreign partners and professional communities.

values.title: Speed and efficiency
values.description: Optimization of expert production timelines without compromising quality.

values.title: Objectivity and independence
values.description: Each conclusion is based on facts, scientific data and strict compliance with legislation.

values.title: Individual approach
values.description: We consider the specifics of each case, the questions posed and the submitted materials when forming expert research.

international.title: cooperation
international.intro: ANSE builds professional ties through real expert, educational and methodological work at national and international levels.

items.title: Expert presentations and educational activities
items.description: ANSE specialists regularly give lectures and practical sessions for law enforcement and supervisory bodies, as well as in professional education programs, sharing applied forensic experience.

items.title: Participation in international conferences
items.description: ANSE experts regularly speak at international forums and share their developments with colleagues.

items.title: Interaction with law enforcement bodies
items.description: ANSE participates in professional dialogue with prosecution and investigative structures to improve appointment quality, question formulation and evidence evaluation.

items.title: International professional ties
items.description: The Alliance develops cooperation with foreign experts and forensic specialists, including contacts with Turkish and European experts.

items.title: Memorandums and partnership agreements
items.description: Memorandums of cooperation are concluded with educational, scientific and expert organizations for method exchange, joint research and competence development.

items.title: Integration into the international expert community
items.description: ANSE aims to participate in European and international professional associations to exchange methods, expertise and comply with international standards.

forAuthors.title: Guide for authors
forAuthors.lead: A professional platform for exchange of experience, practice analysis and methodology development in forensic expertise.
forAuthors.topicIntro: The journal accepts materials related to the following directions:

policy.legal: legal and procedural aspects of forensic expertise;
policy.methodology: methodology and practice of expert research;
policy.caseAnalysis: analysis of judicial practice and expert cases;
policy.internationalStandards: international experience and standards in expert activity;
policy.digitalization: digitalization, automation and AI applications in expertise;

forAuthors.architectureIntro: Materials are accepted within the following sections:

proc.title: I. Procedural issues
proc.description: Analytics of legislative changes, court practice, expert interaction with process participants, and issues of appointment and evaluation of expertise.

practice.title: II. Practice of forensic expertise
practice.description: Practice-oriented materials devoted to methods application, case analysis, practice training, approaches review and recommendations for experts.

industry.title: III. Industry interest
industry.description: Materials on specific types of forensic expertise including construction, medical, psycho-pedagogical, economic, environmental, engineering and other specialized directions.

opinion.title: IV. Expert opinion
opinion.description: Author columns, analytical materials, professional discussions and debate on topical issues of expert activity.

international.title: V. International practice
international.description: Reviews of foreign forensic systems, international standards (ISO, ENFSI etc.), expert participation in international projects, interviews and translations.

special.title: VI. Special issues and interviews
special.description: Thematic issues dedicated to specific sectors or problems, as well as interviews with leading experts, scholars, judges and officials.

digital.title: VII. Digitalization and expertise
digital.description: Publications on digital platforms, software products, accounting systems, AI and cases of digital transformation of expert organizations.

forAuthors.requirementsIntro: Original materials not previously published or under consideration elsewhere are accepted.
materialRequirements: have applied or methodological value for the expert community;
be presented in a professional, neutral and well-argued style;
authorsInvited: developers of methods, standards and digital solutions in the field of expertise.
reviewProcess: peer review according to the journal policy.
